title: Webhooks
intro: A webhook makes your code host tell Agentry the moment a pull or merge request changes, instead of waiting for the next read. It only makes Agentry read sooner: Agentry reads the request again and changes nothing because of what a notice says. Without a webhook, or if a notice is lost, it keeps reading every few minutes.
none: No project has a code host remote yet, so there is nothing to register a webhook on.

noAddress.title: Agentry has no public address.
noAddress.body: Hosts cannot reach this far: open the tunnel in Settings → Remote access.

text.active: {{host}} delivers the notices and Agentry reads the pull request again at once.
text.off: Without a webhook, Agentry reads the pull requests every {{count}} min. With one it finds out at once.
text.failing: {{host}} cannot deliver the notices: Agentry's address answered with an error.
text.stale: The webhook points to an address that is no longer Agentry's. Agentry points it at the new one by itself when it can; until then, remove it or wait.
text.noAddress: Registering a webhook needs a public address. Meanwhile Agentry reads the pull requests every {{count}} min.
text.noAddressStale: The tunnel is closed, so {{host}} no longer reaches Agentry. When there is a new address, Agentry points the webhook at it.

remove.title: Remove the webhook of {{project}}
remove.body: Agentry will delete the webhook of {{repo}} on {{host}} and stop receiving its notices. Pull requests will keep being read every {{count}} min. You can register it again whenever you want.

register.title: Register a webhook on {{project}}
register.addressNote: This is Agentry's public address right now. {{host}} signs each notice with the secret; Agentry checks it before reading anything.
register.eventsNote: Agentry chooses them: they are the ones needed to follow a pull request, and they only make it read sooner. They cannot be changed here.
register.secret: Agentry makes a 32-byte secret, keeps it and gives it to {{host}} when it registers the webhook. It is never shown again. If the repository already has a webhook at this address, Agentry adopts it instead of creating another. Registering needs administration permission on the repository.
register.session: Registered with {{cli}}, with the session of {{user}}
register.sessionPlain: Registered with {{cli}}, with its own session
register.failed: Agentry could not register the webhook.
register.noPermission: {{host}} did not let Agentry register the webhook.
register.noPermissionBody: The {{cli}} session has no administration permission on this repository. Ask the owner for it and try again.

reason.noPublicUrl: Agentry has no public address for a host to deliver to.
reason.noRemote: This project has no code host remote.
